title: Compatibility entropy and the spectrum of a Thorp sweep

abstractEnglish: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ cards mixes in $`\Theta(d)`$ physical shuffles. After a sufficiently large fixed number of coordinate sweeps, the total-variation distance of the full permutation from uniform tends to zero as $`d\to\infty`$.
